rationale: After 53 minutes in the trade and reaching a maximum favorable excursion of 0.87% (~$34.40), upward momentum has stalled below the $34.55 target and price has now slipped below the 5-minute 9-EMA ($34.24) on the most recent 1-minute selling bar.
